## ZGTA V — TrollStore installer

**Build91 test candidate · by zema.**

Install this package in Sileo to download the exact verified IPA and pass it to your existing TrollStore or TrollStore Lite installer. It checks size and SHA-256 before installation.

Requires a compatible TrollStore setup and your own game files. An existing non-TrollStore app with the same identifier is not forcibly overwritten.

### Build91
Corrects the archive-access path after the Build90 phone log reported Operation not permitted. Keeps each discovered file with its folder grant and coordinates the actual provider content read, including multipart sets. Archives and unrelated saves are preserved in local tests.

Local native build/package, actual macOS extraction/access-lifetime/cancellation and three Simulator UI cases pass. Actual Build91 phone/provider/RAR testing, gameplay, save upgrades and reboot behavior remain pending. Keep the app and its data installed.
